plan.goal: Exhaustively evaluate the OrbitRide booking flow from initial search to confirmation, with a strong emphasis on cross-page state persistence (passenger count, total price) and mobile usability.
plan.summary: The exploration will start on the landing page to test the search inputs, paying special attention to the datalist autocomplete and date pickers. It will then navigate to the routes page to test filtering logic, proceed to the SVG seat map to validate seat selection rules based on passenger count, and finish by passing through the passenger details, extras, and payment pages to verify the checkout flow.
assumptions: The booking flow strictly follows the sequence: index -> routes -> seats -> passengers -> extras -> payment -> confirmation.
The passenger count selected on index.html dictates the number of seats required on seats.html and the number of forms on passengers.html.
The mock data supports generic city names or specific autocomplete options for the Midwest.
risk_hotspots: From/To city autocomplete behavior across browsers and viewports.
Mobile layout and usability of the left-hand filter sidebar on routes.html.
SVG interactive seat map on seats.html (checking selection limits matching passenger count).
Top navigation links (OrbitRide, Routes, Help, Sign in) failing mobile tap target sizing (currently ~21px height).

phases.title: Search and Landing Setup
phases.objective: Verify the search widget inputs, datalist interactions, and mobile navigation.
key_checks: Type partial city names into FROM/TO to trigger autocomplete.
Set PASSENGERS to a value > 1 to track it later.
Attempt to submit an empty form to check validation.
Verify top navigation links on mobile viewport.
exit_criteria: Successfully filled the search form and navigated to routes.html.

phases.title: Routes and Filtering
phases.objective: Ensure the routes page accurately updates based on filters and displays correctly on mobile.
key_checks: Toggle 'Departure time' select, 'Max price' slider, and 'Amenities' checkboxes.
Verify that the route list updates or behaves correctly with filters.
Click a 'Select' button for a specific trip.
exit_criteria: Filters have been interacted with and the user has successfully navigated to seats.html.

phases.title: Seat Selection Logic
phases.objective: Validate the SVG seat map interactions and passenger count enforcement.
key_checks: Attempt to select more seats than the passenger count.
Attempt to proceed with fewer seats than the passenger count.
Interact with different seat types (priority vs standard) to see price updates.
exit_criteria: Successfully selected the exact number of required seats and progressed to passengers.html.

phases.title: Checkout Flow Completion
phases.objective: Walk through passenger details, extras, and payment to reach confirmation.
key_checks: Verify the number of passenger forms matches the initial count.
Add an extra (e.g., baggage) and check if the total price updates.
Complete payment form with mock data.
Verify final confirmation details reflect the choices.
exit_criteria: Reached confirmation.html with no blocking errors.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 7 HTML pages defined in the site structure.
coverage_targets.features: Exercise search autocomplete, route filters, SVG seat selection, and dynamic pricing.
coverage_targets.mobile: Evaluate navigation tap targets, filter sidebar layout, and SVG seat map scaling.

notes: Since this is a fictional clone, expect local storage or URL parameters to pass state between pages rather than a backend database.
